waves.rationale: Done. Workspace and pinned toolchain; every Feature depends on it. Commit 3b3fa13f.
Done. Typed config and local PostgreSQL. Commit 3b3fa13f.
Every upstream is done. FEAT-007, FEAT-008, and FEAT-009 belong to phases 3 and 4 but have no unmet edge, so they start early.
Needs the contracts package from FEAT-004.
Needs persistence (FEAT-003), contracts (FEAT-004), identity (FEAT-005), and observability (FEAT-007).
Needs the profile API (FEAT-006) and the app shell (FEAT-009).
Both need the finished API and screen. Neither depends on the other.
The quality manifest lists the test framework's commands (FEAT-011).
The knowledge base describes the manifests (FEAT-012).
FEAT-015 needs FEAT-014. FEAT-017 needs FEAT-013 and FEAT-014. Neither depends on the other.
The role skills read the manifests (FEAT-012) and the contract and UI skills (FEAT-015).

syncPoints.description: Push tbi/create-eexpress-app so cloud agents can branch from it.
Merge all five branches into the integration branch. FEAT-005 needs FEAT-004; FEAT-006 needs FEAT-003 and FEAT-007.
Merge identity before the profile API.
Merge the profile API before the profile screen.
Merge the screen before tests and the container.
Merge skills and handoff before the role skills.
